summary_oneline: A2UI v1.0 renderer for FormDesigner FormSchema covering render → validate → submit → response over A2UI envelopes
restated_ask: Add an `a2ui` output format to parrot-formdesigner that lowers any FormSchema into an A2UI v1.0 `createSurface` envelope (Basic Catalog primitives + ai-parrot `parrot_*` metadata extensions, no `Form` component), whose submit Button action targets the form's own answer endpoint, and make that endpoint speak A2UI back (validation errors / confirmation) so a v1.0 renderer can drive the whole fill-and-submit cycle without an LLM agent in the loop.

constraints.statement: No `Form` catalog component: a form is a composition of Basic input primitives plus a `Button.action.event` (spec G6). The renderer must lower, never register a Form.
constraints.implication: Reuse/generalise build_form's lowering; no new top-level Form schema.

constraints.statement: Envelopes carrying `action` are TOOL-origin only; `validate_envelope(origin=ProducerOrigin.LLM)` rejects them.
constraints.implication: Renderer validates its output with origin=TOOL; the envelope must never be re-emitted through an LLM-origin producer path.

constraints.statement: ai-parrot presentation semantics live under `metadata.extensions.parrot_*`, never as bare top-level props.
constraints.implication: Form/section/field identity (form_uid, field_id, field_uid, section_id, FieldType, dependency hints) ride in `parrot_*` extension keys.

constraints.statement: Only 5 input primitives (TextField, CheckBox, ChoicePicker, DateTimeInput, Slider) and 5 validation functions (required, regex, length, numeric, email) exist vs 47 FieldTypes and ~15 FieldConstraints.
constraints.implication: A mapping table with an explicit degraded set is mandatory; renderers must record RenderedForm.warnings like other renderers.

constraints.statement: `DataBinding.path` must be a valid JSON Pointer; the submit wire contract is field_id-keyed.
constraints.implication: field_ids containing `/` or `~` need RFC 6901 escaping in paths and un-escaping on receipt; dataModel keys map 1:1 to field_id.

constraints.statement: Today every A2UI `action` is routed into an LLM agent turn (A2UIRuntime) at an agent-scoped endpoint; no form-scoped action receiver exists, and web renderers declare supports_actions=False.
constraints.implication: The 'submit points to the form endpoint' requirement needs the FormDesigner submit path to accept an A2UI action envelope (or a client that posts context to /data) — see U1.

constraints.statement: The render dispatcher passes only `locale` and serialises dict content with the renderer's content_type; unknown format keys return 415.
constraints.implication: Registering `"a2ui"` is enough for GET .../render/a2ui; prefilled/errors are not reachable through this route today.

constraints.statement: ai-parrot core is an optional extra of parrot-formdesigner; the audio renderer imports parrot.* lazily inside try/except ImportError.
constraints.implication: A2UIFormRenderer imports parrot.outputs.a2ui lazily and is skipped/raises a clear error when the extra is absent.

constraints.statement: Submit responses are plain JSON: 200 composite on success, 422 {is_valid:false, errors:{field_id:[..]}} on validation failure; lifecycle hooks and persistence run inside submit_data.
constraints.implication: An A2UI response must be produced by translating this result, not by bypassing submit_data.

integration_risks.risk: Action sink mismatch: standard A2UI clients POST actions to an agent endpoint; a form surface must tell the client where to send the action (context.submit_url) or FormDesigner must expose an A2UI-speaking receiver.
integration_risks.mitigation: Decide U1; whichever is chosen, keep the standard `action` envelope shape so Adaptive Cards/Teams and deep-link paths keep working.

integration_risks.risk: 47 → 5 primitive coverage gap; complex types (GROUP/ARRAY/relations/uploads) cannot be expressed natively.
integration_risks.mitigation: Explicit degraded set + warnings; consider Parrot-catalog form components later (U3).

integration_risks.risk: field_id → JSON Pointer escaping and dataModel size cap (A2UI_MAX_DATA_MODEL_BYTES) on large forms.
integration_risks.mitigation: RFC 6901 escape helper with round-trip tests; keep dataModel to answers only.

integration_risks.risk: Tenant/public auth: the render route is a public-form glob; an A2UI receiver must apply the same enforce_membership_unless_public rule.
integration_risks.mitigation: Reuse the existing wrappers on any new route.

integration_risks.risk: Optional dependency: parrot-formdesigner without the ai-parrot extra must not break at import.
integration_risks.mitigation: Lazy import; seed registry only when import succeeds, log once.

claims.claim: Renderers plug in via AbstractFormRenderer + register_renderer(format_key); adding `a2ui` needs no new route for rendering.
claims.reasoning: direct read of base.py and render.py

claims.claim: A2UI v1.0 forbids a Form component; forms are Basic-primitive compositions with Button.action.event (build_form is the in-repo precedent).
Only TextField/CheckBox/ChoicePicker/DateTimeInput/Slider inputs and required/regex/length/numeric/email checks exist to map 47 FieldTypes and FieldConstraints.
The existing submit endpoint is `POST /api/v1/{tenant}/forms/{form_uid}/data` taking field_id-keyed JSON and returning 200/422 JSON.
No A2UI action receiver exists outside the agent-scoped A2UIRuntime path; the runtime turns actions into LLM turns.
ai-parrot extensions belong in metadata.extensions.parrot_*; the renderer can carry form identity there without breaking official-schema validation.
parrot-formdesigner has zero A2UI code today and treats ai-parrot as an optional extra.
Adaptive Cards is the only shipped A2UI renderer that dispatches actions; browser renderers do not, so the browser half of the cycle depends on the consuming client.
Prefilled values and per-field errors can ride in `dataModel` and `checks` respectively, but the render dispatcher does not pass prefilled/errors today.
claims.reasoning: inferred: models support it; handler signature omits it

claims.claim: A2UI `ErrorMessage` with surfaceId+path can express per-field 422 errors returned by submit_data.
claims.reasoning: model supports (surfaceId, path); mapping semantics not yet exercised in repo

claims.claim: Both code areas are actively changing (FEAT-527 catalog work on 2026-09-05; renderer content-type work 2026-09-02) but nothing in flight targets A2UI forms.
build_form's `_lower_field` can be generalised to serve FormDesigner without duplicating lowering logic.
claims.reasoning: inferred from structure; API widening not yet designed

unknowns.question: Where does the A2UI submit action land? (the 'submit pointing to the current endpoint' requirement)
plausible_answers: a) Extend POST .../forms/{form_uid}/data to also accept a v1.0 `action` envelope (detected by body shape / application/a2ui+json) — one endpoint, dual wire
b) Add a sibling POST .../forms/{form_uid}/a2ui that speaks pure A2UI both ways and delegates to submit_data internally
c) Keep /data JSON-only; the Button context carries submit_url and the client posts plain field_id answers
unknowns.user_answer: a) Dual-wire /data — extend POST /api/v1/{tenant}/forms/{form_uid}/data to also accept a v1.0 `action` envelope (detected by body shape or application/a2ui+json); Button.action.event.context carries the submit URL.

unknowns.question: What should the endpoint answer after an A2UI submit?
plausible_answers: a) Full A2UI cycle: 422 → `error` envelopes with surfaceId+path per field (+ updateDataModel), 200 → confirmation surface (createSurface/updateComponents)
b) Plain JSON as today; only the render half is A2UI
c) Content negotiation: A2UI envelopes when the request was an A2UI action / Accept: application/a2ui+json, JSON otherwise
unknowns.user_answer: a) Full A2UI cycle — 422 → `error` envelopes with surfaceId+path per invalid field (plus updateDataModel); 200 → confirmation via updateComponents/createSurface; plain JSON stays for non-A2UI callers (content negotiation).

unknowns.question: How should FieldTypes with no Basic primitive be handled in v1?
plausible_answers: a) Degrade to TextField/Text notice + RenderedForm.warnings (Basic-only, maximum renderer compatibility)
b) Add Parrot-catalog form components (e.g. FileUpload, Signature, Rating) with lower() fallbacks — 'extensions added by ai-parrot'

c) Hybrid: map everything Basic can express natively (NPS/LIKERT/RANKING → Slider, TAGS/MULTI_SELECT → multi ChoicePicker, HIDDEN → dataModel only), degrade the rest now, Parrot components in a follow-up
unknowns.user_answer: c) Hybrid — map everything Basic can express natively (NPS/LIKERT/RANKING→Slider, MULTI_SELECT/TAGS→multi ChoicePicker, HIDDEN→dataModel only, EMAIL/URL/PHONE→TextField+email/regex checks); degrade the rest with a `parrot_role: notice` Text + RenderedForm.warnings; Parrot-catalog form components in a follow-up.

unknowns.question: Which parts of the interaction cycle beyond render → validate → submit are in scope for v1?
plausible_answers: a) None: partial saves, depends_on visibility and lifecycle-event bridge are explicit non-goals
b) Include partial saves as a second Button action (form.save_partial → POST .../partial)
c) Include depends_on as parrot_* dependency metadata (all fields rendered; client may hide) plus partial saves
unknowns.user_answer: a) Core cycle only — partial saves, depends_on conditional visibility and the lifecycle-event bridge are explicit non-goals for v1.
